Now after some years, I came to bring gifts for the needy to my nation, and offerings;

people.name: Asia
people.line: A Roman province in western Asia Minor.

people.name: Ephesus
people.line: Major city in Asia Minor; important center for early Christianity

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

people.name: Paul
people.line: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles

translations.web: For Paul had determined to sail past Ephesus, that he might not have to spend time in Asia; for he was hastening, if it were possible for him, to be in Jerusalem on the day of Pentecost.
translations.bsb: Paul had decided to sail past Ephesus to avoid spending time in the province of Asia, because he was in a hurry to reach Jerusalem, if possible, by the day of Pentecost.
translations.kjv: For Paul had determined to sail by Ephesus, because he would not spend the time in Asia: for he hasted, if it were possible for him, to be at Jerusalem the day of Pentecost.
translations.asv: For Paul had determined to sail past Ephesus, that he might not have to spend time in Asia; for he was hastening, if it were possible for him, to be at Jerusalem the day of Pentecost.
